args.text: Draft the Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team here: first report time, when kiosk 1 came back, and when both lanes were confirmed working.

Gideon, here's a draft from #inc-vtg-hartford. I haven't emailed it to anyone.

**Hartford gate kiosk incident, 3 Aug 2026**

- **First report:** 10:42 AM. Both inbound lanes at Vantorre's Hartford plant showed a white screen after badge scan. Scheduling from the dispatch office was not affected. The guard logged trailers on paper in the meantime.
- **Kiosk 1 restored:** 11:03 AM. Mateo confirmed the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it.
- **Both lanes confirmed working:** 11:07 AM, posted at 11:08 AM. We kept the incident open for one more arrival cycle.
- **Still open:** Mateo's account can't see the status page. That is tracked as a separate issue under INC-4821.

All times are as posted in the channel. They don't say which time zone, so I assume local Hartford time. Please confirm that before it goes out. The channel also doesn't give a root cause, so I left that out.

If you send this to Mateo at Vantorre, that is an outside address. Ruth Calloway has to approve any outside mail, even a draft. Tell me if you want me to ask her.

Finish Gideon's summary: add that Carrowmere Cloud (Odile) was checking the gateway route and that status-page access is tracked in INC-4821. Post the final version in here as its own message starting with 'FINAL:'.

FINAL: Hartford gate kiosk incident, 3 Aug 2026 (for Mateo's procurement team)
- First report: 10:42 AM. Both inbound lanes at Vantorre's Hartford plant showed a white screen after badge scan. Dispatch-office scheduling was unaffected, and the guard logged trailers on paper meanwhile.
- Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt) was checking the Hartford gateway route from 10:51 AM.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 was checked in and dispatch could see it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM (posted 11:08 AM). The incident stayed open for one more arrival cycle.
- Status-page access for Mateo's account is a separate issue, tracked in INC-4821.
Times are as posted in the incident channel.

Ruth, the FINAL version is now posted in #strategic-random as its own message. I added the Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt) gateway-route check, first seen at 10:51 AM. I also added that status-page access is tracked in INC-4821. I haven't emailed it to anyone. Mail to Mateo would go to an outside address and needs your approval first.
